summary: WAYLOAM v0.4.1.alpha polishes the embedded-routing experience with persistent route builds, phased progress, a map-first Ride screen, richer stage information and selectable expedition POI layers.
highlights: Route builds continue when you leave Planner and expose meaningful progress across the app.
Ride is now map-first with current-stage distance/progress, whole-trip distance and ETA in floating navigation surfaces.
Stages can be isolated on the map and now show ride time, climbing, arrival estimates and useful services.
Camps, water, food, repair, shelters and towns use distinct markers with selectable map layers.
added: App-wide route-build progress that survives navigation between sections.
Single-stage map isolation in Planner and Ride.
Useful stage metrics and stage-specific POI summaries.
Distinct route-notice, climb and expedition POI iconography.
Selectable POI map layers for camps, shelters, water, food, repair and towns.
changed: Ride mode is map-first with floating stage and trip navigation information.
Map camera updates avoid refitting the whole route on every GPS location change.
Progress indicators use Material 3 Expressive native linear wavy indicators.
WAYLOAM compiles against Android 37.2 while retaining targetSdk 36.
fixed: Leaving Planner no longer cancels an in-progress route build.
Route-building no longer appears frozen during long embedded-router work because each major phase reports progress.
Route notices and climbs no longer reuse indistinguishable presentation.
Map POIs can be filtered so useful expedition information does not overwhelm the route.
